subject.title: Make agent identity preamble configurable (replace hardcoded 'personal assistant')

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow public main-agent prompt-identity config surface for replacing or suppressing the hardcoded opening identity line?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding durable prompt identity config affects public config, prompt authority, cache keys, docs, and operator upgrade expectations, so automation should not choose the API shape.

options.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
options.body: Approve a backward-compatible opt-in config surface that keeps the default opener unless an operator explicitly customizes or suppresses it.

options.title: Route through broader prompt API
options.body: Reject a one-line config knob and solve the need through a broader prompt/context customization or plugin contract instead.

options.title: Keep current opener
options.body: Decline new prompt identity config and document that operators must use existing supported context mechanisms instead.

recommendation.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
recommendation.body: Approve a backward-compatible opt-in config surface that keeps the default opener unless an operator explicitly customizes or suppresses it.

likelyOwner.reason: The previous review and timeline already route the remaining product/API question to steipete, while code evidence shows the issue is in a core prompt/config surface.
